description: Card number must be exactly 16 digits
Card expiry year must not be in the past relative to 2026
CVV must be exactly 3 digits
Payment method must be one of CreditCard PayPal GiftCard or Invoice
Outstanding balance must not exceed credit limit for invoice payments
Total amount must be positive
Shipping street must not be empty
Shipping city must not be empty
Shipping ZIP must be 5 digits when shipping country is US
Shipping state must be a 2-letter uppercase code when shipping country is US
Shipping country must be a non-empty code of at most 3 characters
International shipments over 500 dollars must carry insurance
Discount percent must be between 0 and 75
A discount code must be present when discount percent is nonzero
Promo stack count must not exceed the max promo stack
Total amount must equal item count times unit price minus discount
Tax amount must be non-negative
Tax-exempt orders must supply an exemption id
Item count must be at least 1
Inventory available must be non-negative
Non-backorder orders must have sufficient inventory for the item count
Backorder orders must be flagged with warehouse zone BACKORDER
Hazardous items must not use express shipping
Warehouse zone must be one of the known zone codes
Fraud-flagged orders must not be marked priority
Customer email must contain an at sign and a dot
Hazardous item orders require a customer age of at least 21
Refund amount must not exceed the total amount
Refund requested flag must be set when refund amount is nonzero
Gift orders must include a gift message of 1 to 200 characters
B2B orders must include a purchase order number
Currency must be one of USD EUR GBP or CAD
Tax amount must not exceed 30 percent of the total amount
International orders must declare a country code of 2 to 3 characters
Signature-required shipments must have an SLA of at least 24 hours
Priority orders must have an SLA of at most 48 hours
Subscription orders must specify a positive interval in days
Loyalty tier must be one of None Silver Gold or Platinum
Platinum-tier customers must not be fraud-flagged
Subscription interval when set must be at least 7 days
Max promo stack must be at least 1
Loyalty tier None must not receive a discount above 10 percent
Shipping method must be one of Standard Express or Overnight
Express shipping flag must match an Express or Overnight shipping method
Carrier id must be one of UPS FedEx USPS or DHL
Tracking number must be set once the label is printed
Weight must be positive
Parcels over 30kg must not use Standard shipping
